scope: Isolated migration candidate only. Production shared Engine source, original Game compact body/driver/light mapping. Full-game frame pacing and world/Office persistence acceptance belong to the integration report.

glass.diagnostic: engineGameMaterial(10) used alpha=1, routing physical glass to cameraOpaque before the opaque-scene copy. A real RenderVisibilityPlan regression failed before the fix.
glass.fix: Use the canonical Engine glass alpha=.28; preserve tint, optical transmission, IOR, geometry and physical ownership.
glass.observed: Before: opaque black windshield. After: steering wheel, seats and driver visible. Native errors=[], projection physicalBodies=0.

spotShadow.diagnostic: Original four linear-PCF taps compared one centre receiver depth against neighbouring texel depths. A grazing empty ground plane was falsely shadowed.
spotShadow.fix: Analytically project the local receiver plane, compare every original PCF texel at its centre, retain four bilinear taps, 512px maps, frame layouts and .000002 bias. Clear far texels stay unoccluded.

nativeRegression.planeOracle: Three independently projected world points define raster depth; compute invokes original/current WGSL against actual depth texture. Occluder depth remains darker in every sample.

productionScene.limitation: This near camera does not expose the original visible stripes. Do not use it as proof of city-wide shadow quality.

remaining.fullGameQuality: Not claimed. Native city/high-speed performance and temporal QA remain integration work.
remaining.carry: Natural waist-height bent elbows verified by physical solver tests and native r2 screenshots. Rapid yaw presentation may still place the spring-driven load sideways.
remaining.weather: Seven-state live-authority/controlled-staging native capture passed without disabling fog/rain assertions; actual persisted weather timeline is used.

descriptors.proof: Replacing only the current spot-shadow WGSL block with exact HEAD source recovers every old frozen descriptor hash. Layouts/options/counts unchanged.
